name: SteelSeries Rival (older models)
description: Per-LED lighting of the older SteelSeries Rival mice: Rival 100, 105, 106, 110, the Rival 300 family, Rival 600 and Rival 700/710. The Rival 650 / 650 Wireless (1038:172B, 1726) are held back: OpenRGB's colour update for them sends unexplained 0x03 reports (0x03 is the DPI opcode in other Rival protocols). Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesRivalController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command, DPI and polling rate are never touched. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/steelseries-rival.md.
